description: Rslib config for building Lynx external bundles.

exports.name: MainThreadRuntimeWrapperWebpackPlugin
exports.summary: The main-thread runtime wrapper for external bundle.

exports.name: EncodeOptions
exports.summary: The options for encoding the external bundle.

members.name: enableJsBytecode
members.summary: Whether to compile main thread chunks to JsBytecode in the emitted bundle.
members.remarks:
When disabled, main thread chunks are encoded as plain JavaScript source,
which keeps them readable for debugging and speeds up encoding.

Only takes effect for the `'lynx'` target. For the `'web'` target the
`JsBytecode` tag only routes main thread chunks to the correct bundle
slot (the chunk is never bytecode-compiled), so it is always kept.

members.name: engineVersion
members.summary: The engine version of the external bundle.

members.name: target
members.summary:
The output format of the encoded bundle.

- `'lynx'`: the native bundle a Lynx engine loads, via `@lynx-js/tasm`.
- `'web'`: a web binary bundle via `@lynx-js/web-core/encode`, decodable by
  the web platform. Sections are emitted as raw JS (the web runtime wraps
  them at `lynx.loadScript` time), and CSS is folded into the StyleInfo
  section.

exports.name: ExposedLayers
exports.summary: The layer names an external bundle is split by.

exports.name: ExternalObject
exports.summary:
Object form of an external mapping.

Use this instead of the plain global-name form when the external library is
mounted asynchronously (as a Promise) by the consuming application, i.e. the
matching `pluginExternalBundle` external is configured with `async: true`.

members.name: async
members.summary:
Whether the library is mounted as a Promise resolving to the library
namespace. When enabled, the external is emitted as a `promise` external
so importing modules await the mounted value instead of reading it
synchronously.

members.name: libraryName
members.summary: The global name (with optional subpath) of the external library.

exports.name: ExternalsPresetDefinition
exports.summary: Definition for a named externals preset.

members.name: extends
members.summary: Other preset names to include before applying the current preset.

members.name: test
members.summary: Include the assets marked `lynx:main-thread` that pass test assertion.

exports.name: Externals
exports.summary:
External module to global-name mappings used when building Lynx external
bundles.

exports.name: ExternalsPresets
exports.summary:
Enabled externals presets.

Preset names are resolved from the built-in preset definitions plus any
custom definitions passed to [`defineExternalBundleRslibConfig`](api:defineExternalBundleRslibConfig).

exports.name: ExternalsPresetValue
exports.summary:
How an externals preset is enabled.

`true` mounts the preset's libraries synchronously. The `{ async: true }`
object form mounts them asynchronously (as Promises), for the web target
where external bundles are loaded via `fetchBundle().then` — see
[`ExternalObject.async`](api:ExternalObject.async).

exports.name: OutputConfig
exports.type: Required<LibConfig>["output"] & { externals?: Externals; externalsPresetDefinitions?: ExternalsPresetDefinitions; externalsPresets?: ExternalsPresets; globalObject?: "lynx" | "globalThis" }
exports.summary: Output config accepted by Lynx external bundle builds.

exports.name: defaultExternalBundleLibConfig
exports.summary: The default lib config[`LibConfig`](api:LibConfig) for external bundle.

exports.name: LAYERS
exports.summary: The layer names an entry is split by without a DSL plugin.

exports.summary:
